purpose: Finish the original cap400 QfO accuracy evaluation from the separately verified final Leiden partition, without repeating completed HMM searches, profile expansion, or graph clustering.
preflight: Require terminal original failure and terminal successful graph recovery, the exact successful worker command, complete independent graph row/float-bit verification, unchanged complete gene order and full partition coverage, original FASTA/source/tool/runtime identities, and all retained graph/checkpoint/partition hashes. Use a new downstream namespace and never overwrite either parent.
refinement: Invoke the original frozen production _refine_cluster_file with the verified final graph and original FASTA-derived, stably sorted gene metadata. Verify metadata name/species order against the numeric checkpoint before calling. The 78-species production broad-copy-only branch intentionally consumes no sequence-hit mapping; use a sentinel that fails if search-hit access occurs. Keep refinement_profile=default and original edge weights. Preserve the unrefined recovered partition separately and independently validate complete post-refinement coverage.
candidates: Invoke unchanged original _expand_phylogeny_candidates with satellite_v2, the verified numeric accepted-hit arrays, and the post-refinement partition. Validate candidate coverage and the original membership-constraint sidecar. Do not retune thresholds, profile settings, singleton policy, cap, seed, graph order, or component limits.
phylogeny: Use the original frozen replay_phylogeny.py helper with the complete original FASTAs, recovered candidates, original membership constraints, inferred species tree, MAFFT/FastTree, species_overlap root rule, positive_paralogy pair rule, min_variance species-tree rooting, and high_confidence_pair satellite retention. The failed run never completed these trees, so perform the required tree inference rather than claiming nonexistent checkpoint reuse.
scoring: Only after independent full native-content validation, run all six corrected QfO scorers using existing scoring helpers and a fresh short Darwin-safe namespace. Independently read back raw scores, coverage, native pair/root/confidence products, and all content pins. Compare only against the verified original control retained in the failed cap400 parent, not a canonical-order or singleton-policy control.
failure_policy: Attempt each required downstream stage once in this namespace. Preserve any failure; never silently restart, change libraries/parameters, or use incomplete native output as a score.
timing: Report failed fresh full-run, successful cached final-clustering recovery, and new downstream stage costs separately. Do not fabricate original profile counters, replace failed timing with recovery timing, or claim uncontended performance on the shared host.
deliverables: Test and freeze continuation orchestration; commit and push tested code and launch evidence; independently admit completed native outputs and six scores into a fresh comparison-table version while retaining original failure history and unchanged other methods/endpoints.
